scripts.directus:logs: docker compose --env-file directus/.env -f directus/docker-compose.yml logs -f directus
scripts.directus:dump: mkdir -p directus/backups && docker compose --env-file directus/.env -f directus/docker-compose.yml exec -T database pg_dump -U directus -d directus --clean --if-exists > directus/backups/directus.sql && echo 'dumped → directus/backups/directus.sql'
scripts.directus:restore: docker compose --env-file directus/.env -f directus/docker-compose.yml exec -T database psql -U directus -d directus < directus/backups/directus.sql
